comparison.objective: Stretch an O-ring over a threaded plug and seat it square and untwisted in its groove.
comparison.physical_skill: Damage-limited elastic expansion, transfer over threads, release, and local seating correction.
comparison.success_condition: Ring fully seated and released without over-stretch or excessive roll/twist.
comparison.reason: Tests deformable seal installation and elastic-strain control, unlike rigid impact fracture and recovery of independently simulated metal tangs.
